title: LIGHT Hypnotherapy
description: This dataset contains EEG and ECG recordings collected during guided imagery hypnotherapy sessions designed to promote eudaemonic well-being through storytelling and deep visualization. Recordings include a baseline resting-state EEG session and EEG/ECG data from three in-person hypnotherapy sessions, with event markers denoting phase transitions within each session. The dataset is derived from a source OpenNeuro dataset and formatted according to BIDS standards.
methods_description: Participants underwent a baseline 5-minute resting EEG recording two weeks prior to the first hypnotherapy session. During sessions 1, 4, and 8, EEG and ECG data were collected while a hypnotherapist guided participants through relaxation, visualization of a safe place, imagined descent down a path or stairway, visualization of a chair and crown, and a light traveling through the body, followed by a return to alertness. Session events marking hypnotherapist phase transitions were annotated.
